title: Spec check follow-ups: answers survive a restart, main moving mid-check, sitting freeze, dropped Owner needed, shape retry, state dir cleanup

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Later notes from the S116 relay (2026-10-26). (1) Owner answers can be lost from the run brief after a daemon restart or a spec change: decisions live in daemon memory until a run starts; the main checkout keeps the paragraph, so a re-check says ready. (2) The spec check false-fails if the main checkout changes during the check. (3) The sitting can freeze while an answer waits on specMu. (4) The spec-check 'Owner needed' text is dropped. (5) A spec-check shape error has no retry. (6) ~/.local/state/ork/spec-checks dirs are never cleaned up. (7) wave start --json omits held items when the wave starts. (8) At 80x24 the held layout wraps and pushes overlap warnings to '+4 more'. (9) The sitting heading and the question title both use the bold Heading style. (10) The CLI sends Adj:true for keyed questions while the TUI uses reg.Adj. (11) When slicer s392 lands, replace SpecCheckRowID and rule u11 with slicer's role, and revert matrix row r16 with the code. The durable readiness record is slicer s400 (see S142).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: TestOwnerAnswersSurviveARestart; TestSpecChangeDropsStoredAnswers; TestCheckRerunsOnceWhenMainMovesDuringTheCheck; TestCheckRerunsOnceOnAShapeError; TestSittingDoesNotFreezeWhileAnAnswerWaitsOnSpecMu; TestOwnerNeededTextIsKept; TestSpecCheckDirRemovedWhenTheRunLands; TestSpecCheckDirsSweptAtDaemonStart; TestWaveStartJSONIncludesHeldItems; TestHeldLayoutAt80x24KeepsOverlapWarnings; TestSittingHeadingAndQuestionTitleStylesDiffer; TestCLIAdjFlagMatchesRegistryForKeyedQuestions; goldens.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Re-anchor each of the eleven Why items from the code (S116 landed; items 10-11 may depend on slicer s392/s400: check slicer first, skip 11 while s392 is open and say so). Owner decisions 2026-10-27 (interactive): (1) keep owner answers in the spec-check state dir per item (file beside the check), reload after a restart, drop on run start or spec change; (2) and (5) re-run the check once automatically if main moved during it or the report has a shape error, then show the failure; (6) remove an item's spec-check dir when its run lands or the project is removed, plus a daemon-start sweep of dirs older than 14 days whose item no longer exists. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: go test -race ./internal/engine ./internal/daemon ./internal/tui ./internal/cli; goldens (go test ./internal/tui -update, review the diff); go vet ./...; gofmt -l .; slicer check; adj lint.
